english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something in a suitable or proper way.
Use this for the literal sense of doing something in a suitable or appropriate way, rather than for a simple causal result.

examples.english: You need to arrange your time appropriately so you can finish it.
examples.traditional: 你要適當咁安排時間，先至做得完。
